settings.heading: Beauty tools, chosen with care
settings.text: Lumette is an online shop for beauty tools and accessories: the things that sit next to the products, not inside them. Heatless curlers, brush sets, mirrors, organizers, skin tools and nail and lash essentials.

settings.heading: Tools, not formulas
settings.text:
We stay on the tools-and-accessories side of beauty on purpose. It means you'll never need to decode an ingredient list here, and every product can be judged by what it does: how it feels in your hand, how it fits your routine and how long it lasts.

Each product page lists what's in the box, how to use it and the materials we know about.

settings.heading: Honest about delivery
settings.text:
We work with fulfilment partners who pack and ship your order, so we don't hold stock ourselves. Many items ship from overseas, and delivery usually takes 1-3 weeks. We show an estimated window on every product page and send tracking as soon as it exists.

If something isn't right, tell us within 30 days of delivery and we'll fix it.

settings.heading: What we promise
settings.text:
• Plain-spoken product pages. No exaggerated claims and no medical promises.
  • Real reviews only. We only display reviews written by customers who bought the product.
  • Fair returns. 30 days from delivery. Damaged or incorrect items are on us.
  • A person on the other end. Write to us any time through the contact page.
